newsitem.title: UK: British Steel eases as stg creeps above DM3.
newsitem.headline: British Steel eases as stg creeps above DM3.

text.p: Shares in British Steel Plc eased on Friday as sterling crept back above the DM3.0 level, dealers said.
At 1038 GMT, the shares were off 4-3/4p, or almost three percent, to 161, giving back about half of what they recovered during the past week.
After a brief respite earlier this week, the currency resumed its advance amid expectations the newly-independent Bank of England will raise interest rates for the fourth time in four months.
The sharp appreciation in sterling has depressed profits of British Steel and other exporters for months.
Dealers said UK investors remained bearish on the stock.
"It has been the Americans buying the ADRs that helped the market earlier this week," said one. "But the (ADR) buying dried up last night."
